decisions.statement: A page type descends from another page type where any parent that page type names does.
A parent named with its page type and a parent named by slug alone are read alike.
Descent is settled for one page type at a time rather than for a whole path.
A ring among page types is answered rather than followed round.
A parent is read here rather than through the reader that reaches files.
The page types one page type takes from are answered nearest first.

definition: the page types descending from a given page type
